The income before extraordinary items is also significantly lower at -1798, compared to 3105.

The combination of declining shareholder equity, increased liabilities, a significantly lower net income, and a dramatic decrease in EPS strongly indicates a deteriorating financial situation. While sales increased slightly, this wasn't enough to offset rising expenses and other negative factors, leading to substantial losses. The company needs to address its profitability issues, manage its liabilities effectively, and find ways to improve its financial position.
